name: Mesh to SDF Volume Conversion
definition: A technique to convert a manifold 3D mesh into a Signed Distance Field (SDF) volume stored in an atlas texture using a utility sampler.
summary: Mesh to SDF Volume Conversion generates voxelized signed distance fields from watertight meshes using GPU-accelerated ray tracing and fast sweeping, differing from TSDF fusion by relying on a single static mesh instance.
